better_blending.config.title: Better Blending
better_blending.config.vanilla.tooltip: Retains the original Overworld/Nether switch. Other dimensions use the main toggle and exclusion list.
better_blending.config.disabled_dimensio: Leave empty to blend everywhere. Add dimension IDs such as minecraft:the_end or modid:dimension to exclude them.
better_blending.config.invalid_dimension: Enter a valid dimension ID, such as minecraft:the_end.
better_blending.config.excluded_blocks.t: These blocks keep their original appearance and cannot blend into neighbors. Add block IDs such as minecraft:melon or modid:block. Remove entries to allow blending again.
better_blending.config.invalid_block: Enter a valid block ID, such as minecraft:melon.
better_blending.config.strength.tooltip: Controls blending and detail in every dimension. Zero bypasses the effect and material sampling.
better_blending.config.style.tooltip: Choose whether isolated blocks or small placed features keep their own texture instead of being covered by nearby terrain.
better_blending.config.texture_aligned.t: Snap transitions and added texture detail to the receiving block's texture pixels. Uses the current resource pack resolution. Off keeps the original blending style.
better_blending.config.local.tooltip: Strength of one-block material transitions. Zero disables local transitions independently of regional blending.
better_blending.config.regional.tooltip: Strength of wider material transitions on the four-block sampling grid. Zero leaves local blending active.
better_blending.config.detail.tooltip: Scales texture variation and surface lighting. Zero preserves blending without added detail.
better_blending.config.map_size.tooltip: 64-256 blocks on each axis around the camera, rounded down to whole sections. Smaller regions reduce coverage and cache memory.
better_blending.config.refresh.tooltip: Delay between visibility refreshes while stationary. 20 ticks is about one second. Moving or turning also requests a refresh.
better_blending.config.budget.tooltip: Soft world-sampling budget from 0.1 to 5 ms. Lower values take longer to update terrain. GPU transfers have additional cost.
better_blending.config.invalid_budget: Enter a finite number from 0.1 to 5.
better_blending.config.save_failed.toolt: Previous settings remain active. Check the game log for details.
